name: OpenFIGI
tagline: Bloomberg FIGI security identifier mapping for financial instruments
description: OpenFIGI provides a free, open API for mapping third-party financial-instrument identifiers to FIGIs and for searching and filtering instruments and Open Symbology metadata. Official sources do not offer or document paid API access.

auth.details: Optional API key via X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY header for higher rate limits; self-serve signup. Unauthenticated requests allowed at lower limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API with no daily, weekly, or monthly limit. Mapping: 25 requests/minute without a key or 25 requests/6 seconds with a key. Search/filter: 5 requests/minute without a key or 20/minute with a key; maximum 15,000 results, 100 per page, and 150 pages.

rate_limits: Mapping: 25 requests/minute without an API key or 25 requests/6 seconds with one. Search/filter: 5 requests/minute without an API key or 20 requests/minute with one.
use_cases: map a ticker or ISIN to Bloomberg FIGI for regulatory reporting
search financial instruments by name or symbol
normalize security identifiers across market data feeds
